title: The Oath of Office
description: Republic Square. The Constitution. Sixty thousand people in the cold. The swearing-in ceremony marks the end of the Halvek era.

title: The Ledger
description: Vyktor waited until after the ball. It is morning now, and the real numbers — and a sealed folder from the Halvek era — are waiting in your study.

title: Family Dinner
description: Jonas has arranged dinner at the residence. The first night as Chancellor.

title: The Inaugural Ball
description: The Republic celebrates. You must be present.
